notes.title: GRIT - EARLY ACCESS COMING SUMMER
notes.content:
Howdy Partner, 

We’ve been having the time of our lives riding in Sunrise County with you, taking note of your great feedback and improving our wild west royale every day.  After much reflection, and taking into account the great responses, excitement, and expectations set against GRIT during this pre-Early Access playtest period, we have decided to move the launch of Early Access from this Spring to Summer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/a28aa7a96189e1b21463f257f73994750705866c.jpg[/img]


We’ll use the extra handful of months to continue to grind away, as we have a ton on our content and improvement plates.  Everything from animations to movement and progression is being worked on.  

We will still continue to hold periodic playtests in order to have our great community play and experience these improvements as they come.  

Make sure you're following our Discord to stay tuned for the latest updates and future playtest schedules that we’ll announce soon. 

Thanks for your patience and for being part of this community!

- Team GRIT

notes.title: GRIT Playtest on Saturday, May 22nd!
notes.content:
Howdy Partner,

We listened to you, took in feedback, and let the stew cook a little longer but we have some stuff we think you'll appreciate when you return to Sunrise County on [b]Saturday, May 22nd at 8am to 10pm Pacific Time  (4pm BST - 6am BST[/b])! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40223142/2ad8be55f8216ef5f875f7016d496a9b023f2bec.jpg[/img]

We love the energy and support of our enthusiastic GRIT Community and thank you for your great support.  We are looking forward to this next playtest with all of you and based on the results hosting more frequent playtests!

Also, we have planned times for game modes so it is clear to everyone when we're going to run a particular mode since that has been a source of feedback for past playtests:

- 8-10am Pacific Time: (4pm BST - 6pm BST) Solos and Duos
- 10-2pm Pacific Time: (6pm BST - 10pm BST) Squads 
- 2-6pm Pacific Time: (10pm BST - 2am BST) Solos and Duos 
- 6-10pm Pacific Time: (2am BST - 6am BST) Squads
